recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the standalone FHIRPath specification stops publishing the keyword list or FHIR core stops linking to the authoritative FHIRPath specification.
issue_request: FHIR-17249 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core change request asking FHIRPath to include a quick-reference list of keywords instead of exposing them only through the grammar; Jira records the resolution as Already applied.
initial_application: No FHIR-core commit mentioning FHIR-17249 was found. The request appears to have been satisfied in the FHIRPath publication itself: the current published FHIRPath specification and historical 2018May FHIRPath source include a Lexical Elements / Keywords section with the keyword list.
additional_context: Current FHIR core treats FHIRPath as a separate specification and links to FHIRPath release 2 from source/fhirpath.html. Later FHIR-core history, especially FHIR-53208, removed duplicated FHIRPath language-definition material from core because that content belongs in the standalone FHIRPath specification. Zulip discussion from 2018 confirms the original keyword-list concern, and later FHIR-23073 reserved-word discussion uses the FHIRPath keyword section as the reference.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Duplicating the keyword list in FHIR core would be redundant and could drift from the authoritative FHIRPath source; the existing delegation to the published FHIRPath specification satisfies the applied issue.

related_jiras.note: Later reserved-word issue cites the FHIRPath keywords section and clarifies how keyword collisions such as contains and div are interpreted.
Later core issue removed duplicated FHIRPath content from source/fhirpath.html because that language content had moved into the standalone FHIRPath specification.
